project.name: weather-widget
project.description: Static weather widget with retained PWA manifest and service-worker artifacts.

notes: This adoption adds the KiNoTch Base and Project Overlay without replacing the existing PWA manifest, service worker, or static assets.
PWA behavior and browser data policy remain Project-owned.
The current HTML does not activate the checked-in PWA artifacts; installability is not claimed until a Project-owned browser check exists.
